class.name: LRTBakeTask
class.brief_description: Tracks one explicit asynchronous LRT bake.
class.description: Returned by [method LRTVolume3D.bake] and [method LRTGeometryBinding.bake]. Use on the main thread. Scene collection advances incrementally; heavy CPU work and native GPU readback do not require the caller to wait synchronously. A finished result is committed as one resource, not partially exposed. GPU runtime composition with current dynamic geometry continues through the volume's geometry status API. Saving is independent of baking.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Requests cancellation before the commit point. Returns false after completion. Cancellation does not commit a partial resource. The task finishes once in-flight work is safely retired.

method.name: is_completed
method.description: Whether this task reached a terminal status.

method.name: get_progress
method.description: Returns status, phase, completed_sources, completed_slices, capture_usec and elapsed_usec, plus filtered_sources, input_read_bytes, material_evaluations/material_reuses, bvh_builds/bvh_reuses, sdf_distance_reuses and updated_probes. On completion also includes unchanged, volume_recolor, worker_usec, geometry_usec, sampling_usec, error and error_message. input_read_bytes counts actual source Mesh buffer downloads; volume_recolor identifies LTM/emission-only updates retaining geometric visibility. render_thread contains per-stage CPU envelope totals and longest calls for context, capture, prepare, samplers, draw, mesh and readback. Envelopes can nest and must not be summed as exclusive timings. Worker/evaluation durations include cooperative GPU waits; they are not isolated CPU timings.

method.name: get_result
method.description: Returns the committed volume or Color SDF resource after success, including completion with resource issues. Otherwise returns null.

method.name: get_issues
method.description: Returns completed resource issues with node_path, instance_index, surface, pass or triangle, and reason. Returns an empty array before completion.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread after completion, failure or cancellation. Inspect [method get_status] before using [method get_result].

constants.constant: Evaluating or safely retiring worker work.
Result committed with localized missing contributions; inspect [method get_issues].
